market_context: Stocks bounced in the morning after Friday's tech sell-off, when the Nasdaq fell 2.9%, its worst day since June. The rally has since faded: QQQ is down 0.8% from a high of 699, AAPL and MSFT are down about 1.7%, and the VIX is up 6.6% at 20.7. Apple reports after the close, the 10-year yield is near 4.9%, and the US midterm elections are tomorrow. Oil is falling on hopes for Iran peace talks, which supports the Dow and cyclical stocks over tech.

predictions.reasoning: QQQ has faded from a high of 699.43 to 685, and AI-capex worries are still weighing on mega-cap tech (MSFT down 1.75%). Positioning ahead of Apple's after-close report and tomorrow's midterms should keep dip-buyers cautious into the close.
DIA is up 0.7% and holding near the top of its 519.81-523.68 range. Falling oil and rotation out of tech toward value and cyclicals support the Dow.
BTC is down 1.7% and near its day low, and it is down 5.4% over five days. It has tracked the risk-off tone in tech, and the elevated VIX and 4.9% yields are a headwind.
